title: IVG 2400 Reload Lemon and Lime Prefilled Vape Pods - 20mg - 2PK
description: Designed for use with the IVG 2400 Reload Prefilled Pod Kit, these IVG 2400 Reload Prefilled Pods provide an effortless way to refresh your device with bright and citrusy flavours. Each pack contains two individual 2ml prefilled pods, delivering up to 2400 puffs per kit (depending on personal usage) while ensuring smooth and consistent vapour production. The Lemon and Lime Edition delivers a sharp and zesty citrus blend, balancing the tangy brightness of Lemon with the crisp, refreshing notes of Lime. The result is a bold, well-balanced vape that combines sweet and tart elements for a clean and invigorating fruit flavour. Swapping pods is effortless—just replace an empty pod with a fresh one and continue enjoying your vape. Whether you're looking for an easy way to keep your device performing at its best or a simple alternative to disposables, these pods provide a mess-free and reliable vaping solution.
